reason: I'd download it and use the free 5 apps, snapping whiteboards for a couple of classes sounds actually useful. But I don't pay for apps, period. If 50 actions runs out I'll just type stuff into Google Keep until next month.
objection: Six bucks a month is a lot when I make like $8k a year, and Notion, Keep and my phone camera already do this for free even if they don't talk to each other.
would_change_my_mind: A student deal where Plus is free or like $1-2 a month with a school email, or the free tier giving enough actions to cover a whole semester of lecture photos.
